evidence: A user reports successful imports of triggers, lights, materials, and sounds, and calls the workflow awesome for prototyping.

evidence_sources.excerpt: func_godot works better than I expected it to the first time I used it, properly imports and compiles triggers, lights, materials, sounds, etc straight from trenchbroom so you really can do 90% of your work in trenchbroom. It's awesome for prototyping!
